name: Magento
description: Connect your Magento 2 store so the agent can find a customer's orders, track shipments, cancel or re-route unshipped orders, issue refunds, and answer product and stock questions.

magento_get_store.label: Get Store Info
magento_get_store.description: Get basic information about the connected store (code, URL, currency, locale).

magento_find_customer.label: Find Customer
magento_find_customer.description: Find a customer by email (accounts and guest checkouts), with their most recent orders.

magento_list_customer_orders.label: List Customer Orders
magento_list_customer_orders.description: List a customer's orders by email, most recent first.

magento_get_order.label: Get Order
magento_get_order.description: Get an order by id or number: items, totals, address, invoices, tracking and support eligibility.

magento_get_order_tracking.label: Get Order Tracking
magento_get_order_tracking.description: Get an order's shipments and tracking numbers.

magento_cancel_order.label: Cancel Order
magento_cancel_order.description: Cancel a new or pending-payment order that has not been invoiced or shipped.

magento_create_refund.label: Create Refund
magento_create_refund.description: Refund an order via a credit memo, in full, by item, or by amount, capped at the remaining balance.

magento_update_order_shipping_address.label: Update Order Shipping Address
magento_update_order_shipping_address.description: Change where an unshipped order will ship. Refuses once a shipment exists.

magento_add_order_note.label: Add Order Note
magento_add_order_note.description: Add an internal comment to an order, optionally shown and emailed to the customer.

magento_get_product.label: Get Product
magento_get_product.description: Get a product by SKU with price, stock, description and its variants.

magento_check_inventory.label: Check Inventory
magento_check_inventory.description: Check stock status and quantity for a SKU.

magento_resend_order_confirmation.label: Resend Order Confirmation
magento_resend_order_confirmation.description: Resend the order confirmation email to the email on the order.

baseUrl.label: Magento Base URL
baseUrl.description: Your Magento 2 REST API base URL (e.g., https://yourdomain.com/rest/V1)

apiToken.label: API Token
apiToken.description: Magento integration access token (System → Integrations) with access to Sales, Catalog and Customers
